articles.title: Cathay Pacific Flight Briefly Lost Contact, NATO Alerted
articles.summary: A London-bound Cathay Pacific flight briefly lost contact with air traffic control, triggering a low-level NATO alert before normal communication was re-established. While the incident remains under investigation, it underscores the fragility of civilian air traffic command and control systems and the swift, pre-emptive response protocols deployed by military alliances. Such events, however brief, expose potential vulnerabilities in international airspace management and can create momentary geopolitical jitters, especially in congested European air corridors.
